description: Three colleagues in two LOBs raise manual NIGO checks on SIP forms; two propose fixes.

members.one_line: Branch staff re-check every SIP form by hand for missing fields
members.details: At the Hyderabad branch we open each physical SIP form and tick 14 fields on a printed checklist. About one in five forms comes back NIGO a day later anyway. A validation step at scanning would catch most of these.
members.fix: Validate the mandatory fields when the form is scanned, before it reaches the processing queue.

members.one_line: SIF subscription forms bounce for missing nominee details
members.details: In SIF operations the same manual check happens on subscription forms. The most common miss is nominee details. Each bounce costs a call to the distributor.

members.one_line: NIGO forms found too late, after the cut-off
members.details: We only learn a form is NIGO after the NAV cut-off, so the investor loses a day. A checklist inside the scanning app would flag gaps while the distributor is still at the counter.
members.fix: Show missing fields in the scanning app while the distributor is still at the counter.

output.name: Manual NIGO checks on subscription forms
output.description: Operations teams check subscription forms for missing fields by hand, and gaps are found too late; raised by three colleagues in two LOBs.
output.problem: Physical SIP and SIF subscription forms are checked by hand against a printed list of mandatory fields. Gaps such as missing nominee details are still found only after processing, often after the NAV cut-off. Investors lose a day and branches spend time calling distributors back.

variations.note: The same manual check happens in SIF operations; missing nominee details are the most common gap.
The cost is timing: gaps found after the cut-off cost the investor a day.

solution.text: Validate mandatory fields at scanning, before the form reaches the processing queue.
Show missing fields in the scanning app while the distributor is still at the counter.

open_questions: What share of NIGO cases come from fields a scanner could check?
Does the SIF form use the same scanning app as MF?
